newsitem.title: USA: AMR says matches United summer fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: AMR says matches United summer fare cuts.

text.p: AMR Corp, parent of American Airlines, said on Thursday it would match a summer North American airfare sale announced earlier by UAL Corp's United Airlines.
Continental Airlines Inc and US Airways Group Inc have also said they would match the fares.
Under the fare sale, tickets must be bought no later than April 29 for travel through October 8, an AMR spokesman said.
United said it was cutting summer fares for travel throughout the U.S. and Canada by up to 40 percent.
